name: Market and Management Anthropology
summary: Anthropology used as a business tool: fieldwork, cross-cultural analysis and the study of how people actually behave as consumers, combined with management. It includes a compulsory period of fieldwork abroad in a country you choose. SDU runs it as a "signature programme" — a small intake with intense teaching and frequent feedback — and it is the only fully English-taught bachelor's degree on the Odense campus.
